verses.text: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
lines: Oh clap your hands, all you nations.
Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

verses.text: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
lines: For Yahweh Most High is awesome.
He is a great King over all the earth.

verses.text: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
lines: He subdues nations under us,
and peoples under our feet.

verses.text: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved.
lines: He chooses our inheritance for us,
the glory of Jacob whom he loved.

verses.text: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.
lines: God has gone up with a shout,
Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.text: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
lines: Sing praises to God! Sing praises!
Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

verses.text: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
lines: For God is the King of all the earth.
Sing praises with understanding.

verses.text: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
lines: God reigns over the nations.
God sits on his holy throne.

verses.text: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
lines: The princes of the peoples are gathered together,
the people of the God of Abraham.
For the shields of the earth belong to God.
He is greatly exalted!
